text:
emily: Quick dry run — final copy for the product announcement blog. Need a fast QA on the hero claim, the benchmark line, and HubSpot lead tagging before I send to legal. Target publish Tue 9am PT. Can everyone skim?

jordan: On it. I can do a POV pass in 30. Do we have a final CTA and webinar CTA mapped?

mike: Draft hero: 'Consistent sub-100ms LLM inference at scale' — short, claim-y but accurate. Benchmark line below: 'On our Dedicated tier we saw sustained throughput of ~1M tokens/hour with >90% parity to developer test prompts.' Thoughts?

alex: Hero sounds fine. Recommend the hero visual copy be 'Sub-100ms inference at scale' (drop "consistent") so it reads cleaner in the banner.

mike: Agree with alex. Also suggest we avoid raw percentages without context. Maybe 'with high fidelity across standard prompt suites' instead of >90%.

nora: For lead routing, we'll need UTMs + HubSpot property mapping. Proposed UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=product_x_announce. HubSpot props: lifecycle_stage=lead, interest=dedicated, campaign=product_x_launch. Can marketing ops wire these in?

emily: @nora yes please — list below is what we'll add to the CTA buttons and webinar signup. We also need the webinar invite flow to trigger a dedicated lead tag so Sales Ops can follow up.

nora: Copy for ops (paste into the CTA href):
```
https://redwood.ai/product-x?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=product_x_announce
```
And HubSpot hidden fields: `campaign=product_x_launch`, `lead_source=blog_content`, `interest=dedicated`

samira: Quick legal flag: avoid words like "guarantee" or absolute superlatives vs competitors. Replace any direct competitor references with neutral phrasing. Add a 1-line privacy note near the webinar signup: "We process personal data per our Privacy Policy."

mike: Got it — edit hero to "Sub-100ms inference at scale" and benchmark to "sustained throughput of ~1M tokens/hour with high fidelity on standard prompt suites." Less numeric certainty.

jordan: Also, can we add a small callout under the benchmark for the test environment: hardware/seq len? Helps with reproducibility: "Tests run on 8xA100, sequence length 512, mixed-batch workloads."

emily: Good point. Keep that callout collapsed on mobile.

alex: Visual assets: I'll update the hero layout and add a benchmark chart thumbnail. Need final copy by EOD to generate the PNGs.

publish-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1716161616 — expires in 48h :rocket:

nora: Ops note: when we publish, make sure the lead tag 'product_x_launch' is added server-side for direct clicks (not just the form). I'll coordinate with infra.

samira: Approved for legal send — flag me again after final copy update. I can do a quick pass (30m).

emily: Thanks everyone. I'll make the edits (hero + benchmark + test env callout), wire UTMs, and tag @samira for legal. Aim to send legal by 5pm PT. If all clears, we'll stick with Tue 9am PT publish. :thumbsup:

mike: One last micro ask — can we include a short customer quote placeholder? e.g., "Redwood reduced our inference latency and cost." We'll swap with the real quote later but helps layout.

emily: Added a placeholder block and noted for replacement in the schedule.

publish-bot: reminder scheduled: send legal signoff ping at 17:05 PT to @samira

emily: Done — I updated the draft and pushed to the preview. Will post when legal OKs. Thanks all! :party_popper:
